what_it_does.name: test-driven-development
what_it_does.summary: Instructions in two Markdown documents for test-driven development by an agent, with no scripts. Write the test first, watch it fail for the expected reason, write minimal code to pass, then refactor while the project's whole suite stays green, and delete any production code written before its test. A reference on writing good tests covers naming the break each test catches, asserting real behavior instead of mock behavior, and a mutation check. Use it when implementing any feature or bugfix, before writing implementation code.
tasks: write one minimal failing test before any production code
verify the test fails because the feature is missing
write the simplest code to pass, then refactor while green
fix a bug by first writing a failing test that reproduces it
write tests that assert real behavior, not mock behavior
run the project's whole test suite before calling a change done
check every box of the verification checklist before marking work complete

risks.risk: Code the user wanted to keep is lost when the agent applies the rule to delete code written before its test literally and without asking the user.
risks.mitigation: none stated for the deletion, exceptions to TDD need the human partner's permission

risks.risk: Absolute rules that label alternative reasoning as rationalization override the agent's usual procedure, so the agent may hold to the process where the situation called for another approach.
risks.mitigation: exceptions are to be asked of the human partner, in place in the files

risks.risk: Running the project's whole test suite, required even when the task names one test file, executes every test in the repository with the agent's privileges, including tests with side effects.

known_problems.workaround: it tests existing behavior, fix the test

known_problems.problem: the new test errors instead of failing
known_problems.workaround: fix the error and re-run until it fails correctly
the code is too coupled, use dependency injection
extract helpers, and if still complex, simplify the design

known_problems.problem: mock setup outgrows the test logic
known_problems.workaround: switch to an integration test with real components
